texts.agentPushToolDescription: Ask Vibe Work to push a local branch of this chat's repository. Requires Developer permissions in Settings. Ask and Accept edits show an Allow once card; Full access pushes and shows a chat notice. Uses the app's existing credentials without exposing them. Pushes under the branch's own name, skips local hooks, and never forces. Returns the pushed commit and remote branch, or the exact refusal/failure. A slow push returns status:pushing and pushId: call push with only that pushId until settled; do not start another push. Collecting an existing result needs no card and works after the switch is off.
